questions.question_text: Mahārāj kahe je, karoḍ vahāṇe karīne ek manvār bharāy evī _______ bharvī chhe, eṭlā jīvnu kalyāṇ karvu chhe.
questions.explanation: As per Swa.Vato.1/72, Mahārāj states, "karoḍ vahāṇe karīne ek manvār bharāy evī so karoḍ manvāryu bharvī chhe".

questions.question_text: Mahārāj kahe je, karoḍ vahāṇe karīne ek manvār bharāy evī so karoḍ manvāryu bharvī chhe, eṭlā _______ karvu chhe.
questions.explanation: The statement in Swa.Vato.1/72 concludes with, "eṭlā jīvnu kalyāṇ karvu chhe."

questions.question_text: Mahārāj kahe je, _______ ek manvār bharāy evī so karoḍ manvāryu bharvī chhe, eṭlā jīvnu kalyāṇ karvu chhe.
questions.explanation: The text states, "karoḍ vahāṇe karīne ek manvār bharāy evī so karoḍ manvāryu bharvī chhe."

questions.question_text: According to Swa.Vato.1/72, who said: "karoḍ vahāṇe karīne ek manvār bharāy evī so karoḍ manvāryu bharvī chhe, eṭlā jīvnu kalyāṇ karvu chhe."
questions.explanation: The Vato begins with "Mahārāj kahe je," indicating that Mahārāj made this statement.

questions.question_text: According to Mahārāj in Swa.Vato.1/72, how many 'vahāṇe' are required to fill one 'manvār'?
questions.explanation: The Vato states, "karoḍ vahāṇe karīne ek manvār bharāy evī...".

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of filling 'so karoḍ manvāryu'?
questions.explanation: The Vato explicitly states, "so karoḍ manvāryu bharvī chhe, eṭlā jīvnu kalyāṇ karvu chhe."

questions.question_text: How many 'manvāryu' did Mahārāj express a wish to fill?
questions.explanation: The Vato states, "so karoḍ manvāryu bharvī chhe".
